status_note: Gated on Hugging Face (application for academic, non-commercial use with an institutional email). Not on the lab's shared corpus storage

notes: Real-scene Mandarin audio-visual conversations recorded by AISHELL in five locations (office building, residential hall, hotel, park, street), 70 groups. Each session has 1-5 foreground (F) speakers and 1-5 background (B) speakers who talk, phone, walk or queue as interference. Only F-speakers wear a near-field microphone and only their faces are released, so the B-speakers' speech is in the far-field channels without speaker labels. Permutations P1-P3 have one F-speaker (single target with interference); P4 has two and P5 has 3-5 F-speakers (P4 + P5: 52 of 70 groups). About 25% of speech segments overlap (paper; a share of segments, not of time). Train 79.84 h, Dev 10.70 h, Eval 11.65 h, speaker- and session-disjoint. Transcription format and whether it carries speaker-attributed times not seen (README and specification PDF behind the gate).
